subject: Architecture docs and exam coverage report now available
body: GA — published two new docs useful for exam renderer work. (1) docs/architecture.md: full system overview, data flow diagram, tech stack table, agent file ownership, constraints. (2) docs/data-model.md: complete RP JSON schema with all fields, types, rules, and verify requirements. Also shipped: scripts/gp-exam-coverage.js which reports per-exam stats. Current numbers: 150 questions total, 20 graph questions (2/exam), 100% hint coverage, 84 multi-input, 66 single-input, 241 number inputs, 50 text inputs. Exam audit confirmed: feedback_correct, feedback_wrong, hint, and solution_steps are all being rendered correctly in exam.html with appropriate fallbacks. No action needed from GA — this is an FYI and doc reference.
